How scores work
  • Community Growth: direct new users' event trading volume counts after each user reaches 10 U cumulatively.
  • New User Trading: direct new users qualify for the personal ranking at 1,000 U cumulative volume.
  • Lucky Draw: new users earn 1–3 entries at the 500 / 3,000 / 10,000 U milestones.
Only direct (first-level) users count. Second-level users are excluded. Community Leaders and affiliated accounts cannot enter the New User Trading ranking or draw.
Zero-volume entries are hidden and take no ranking spot.

Participation
  1. Register a valid invite code. Community Leaders submit all their valid codes through their BD.
  2. Invite new users. Users register through the leader's link during the event and trade.
  3. Help users qualify. Personal trading milestones unlock the Top 10 ranking and draw entries.
  4. Share updates. Community Leaders forward official progress and ranking notices in their groups.
Community promotion

Registration

Community Leaders: contact your BD and submit all valid invite codes together.

Invite code rule: codes belonging to the same leader are combined into one ranking position. They must not have a direct or indirect upline/downline relationship.
After registration, post the unified event announcement in your community so users actually receive it.
  • Use the official copy, rule graphic and event link.
  • Send your BD a screenshot of the post and its message link.
  • Forward important progress and rank-change updates during the event.
Important notes

Fair counting

Only direct new users registered during the event are eligible. One user's transaction must not be duplicated within the same ranking.

Eligible accounts

Community Leaders and affiliated accounts cannot enter the New User Trading Top 10 or the Lucky Draw.

Final results

All rankings and prizes are subject to review and the audited, locked event results.
